scope: Diff against main; public inputs, table ownership, menu refusal, deterministic sampling, paired scoring and storage
invariants: The witness reducer consumes public wagers and board events; K50 keys use the observation owner's hole cards and the policy's explicitly pinned tables.
Translation reuses positive-mass rows with matching action labels. Actual legal raise amounts stay in the real menu. Known and zero-mass rows skip translation.
K50 configure_translation validates both pinned table hashes and the model identity. Missing table arguments cannot fall back to registered global tables. All v2 schemas refuse translation.
Each policy sample consumes one unchanged RNG draw; search uses none. v1 complete deterministic match streams equal main byte for byte.
The two arms share immutable average/cache storage but have separate translation configuration, players and descriptions.
Panel arms share physical deals and role action streams; inference sees no evaluation seed/outcome data. Student-t intervals use duplicate blocks, with the exact predeclared strict inequalities.

Replay reconstructs fresh engine hands and own equity readers; selected witnesses are independently checked with engine histories. Reproduction compares every deterministic decision field and every complete hand.
No final mean is calculated before the global replay/reproduction barrier and raw hashes are rechecked. Every primary and repeat stream remains retained.
Detached M4 guards retain five-second observations, reset sustained timers across gaps, share one swap baseline and verify PID creation times before signals.
No model/cache/table payload enters Git, no release/default is changed, and server preparation is conditional without live API play.
